scope: All12 sentence/task sets compared with Japanese premises/exchanges; metadata/native/device certification excluded.

sourceIssues.issue: Source dialogue 今日は後にします can mean later today, whereas hint explicitly says後日に. All12 targets follow hint postponement to another day; Japanese scheduling intent remains editorially unresolved.

私が終わるまで、そこにいると伝えました has an implicit subject within reported speech; targets generally interpret telling friend to stay behind until player finishes. Hint confirms friend waiting but does not resolve reported-speech agency; source editorial clarification remains open.

reviewCriteria: Gifu13–14: distinguish collar seam/inside label from whole fabric; check contact position and try-on rules before purchase/label cutting. Wake-up assistance at06:30 separate from own vibration/charging; unconfirmed room visit never booked, no guaranteed waking.

Gifu15–16: grandfather original retained, copies and added lettering distinct, photo blue-as-black not reliable color sample; sensory load shortens own shopping without ending companion shopping, contact before separating, no promised immediate return.

Gifu17–18: timeline layout not equal dates, heading versus entry dates and single year versus longer period; Saturday00:30 follows Friday night, exact reservation date/service/location distinct from assumption and replacement ticket purchase.

Gifu19–20: remembered aroma uncertain, low salt and soft noodles distinct, nostalgia no reproduction guarantee; waiting area not simultaneous machine operation, no self-changed PPE, uncertain repeated send and malfunction not permission to resume.
Gifu21:60000yen is60percent of100000 or half of120000; current balance distinct from tentative targets and departure date, planning consultation not savings contract.

Minokamo08/Toki01: friend retains glasses, call from safe stopping point and precise landmark before any movement; pottery only suspected broken after crack, no injury or bare-hand search, closed box supported, consult shop not station repair, fragments reported before boarding.

Toki02–03: handouts for missed session not retrospective attendance or substitute family attendance, next preparation not counter lecture repeat; own coat/wallet and food bag kept together until placement instructions, self-carry possible, check both when leaving.

Toki04–05: harsh note found after shopping, unobserved author and previous scratch unrelated until proven, unaltered paper and suspicion not evidence; pop-up house card not crushed/disassembled, measure protected package not bare card, postage chosen after packaging.

Toki06–07: last calendar month first-to-last, passbook/ID held, collection date pending and two priority questions; heating versus dishwasher compatibility checked independently per actual product with label retained, similar appearance no shared suitability.

Toki08/Kakamigahara01: chalk on paving not paint, drawing stopped, guardian present and no water cleanup or self-declared restoration; aircraft exhibit symbol not direct airport train, airport booking and station departure versus flight time checked separately.

Iwata06–07: Aonami leaflet versus Yamate counter, issuer contacted before travel/forms, single booklet returned; own cake reservation no slip located, mobile confirmation, chocolate/number6/name checked before closure and later slip marked collected.

Iwata08/Yaizu01: two repetitions left, observe one then participate only as able,09:00 next gathering; loose shoelace not urgent boarding, lap-held bag and foot reposition before tugging, companion notified and waiting at exit.

Yaizu02–03: circulating neighborhood papers held due rain/absent household, district contact/order checked and dry storage pending; workplace badge not hospital-issued, clasp avoids hair snag, card stays attached, reception paper remains in hand and other examination removals await staff.

Yaizu04–05: bag drop accidental alarm activation not pursuit, detached part replaced by owner with indicated location, instructions read before reuse; thick unbent envelope/backing retained, fictional500yen postage minus350yen affixed leaves150yen, sealed address unchanged.

Yaizu06–07: found suspended card reported before replacement, no post-find ATM/payment use, distinguish older card and wait identity/status check; two fish portions separately wrapped/stored, fish insulated versus bread tote, unequal weights larger for dinner and pay two packages.
